column1: # Which Juice Shop 20.2.0 challenges this lab can reach, and what each needs (tools/juiceshop_score.py, D-060).
# One row per challenge of the catalogue (tools/juiceshop/challenges-v20.2.0.json), in its order; the
# scorer stops if a key or name no longer matches. Columns are separated by one tab. Reviewed against
# Juice Shop's own source at the v20.2.0 tag (github.com/juice-shop/juice-shop, commit 5658473): the
# file or route named in `source` is what decides the row. Nothing here was learnt by running Juice
# Shop or by reading its challenge list through the lab.
# reach    yes          possible offline in this lab: enabled in Docker, and everything the challenge
#                       needs is served by the lab (general knowledge aside, see note)
#          no-docker    disabled by Juice Shop itself in Docker (its safety mode)
#          no-llm       needs the chatbot's LLM endpoint, which the lab does not have
#          no-chain     needs a blockchain node (Sepolia through Alchemy) on the internet
#          no-internet  the answer exists only on the internet (a paste, a video, social media, a
#                       binary on GitHub), not in anything the lab serves
#          no-front     the lab's front (lab/juiceshop.conf) refuses the route or the only page that
#                       carries what the challenge needs (/api/Challenges, /rest/continue-code, D-060)
# needs    what observing the issue itself takes:
#          read         signed out, GET/HEAD/OPTIONS only (a crafted header or query included)
#          write        a state-changing request without a session of one's own (a sign-in, a
#                       registration, a feedback, a PUT, or a GET that changes state)
#          account      a signed-in session of an ordinary user the tester registered
# solve    what Juice Shop's own solved check takes, in the same terms
# browser  yes: Juice Shop marks it solved only on a socket.io event its Angular page sends while
#          rendering (an agent that sends HTTP requests cannot solve it, though it can identify it)
# source   the file or route of Juice Shop 20.2.0 that decides the row
# note     what else the row depends on ("-" for nothing)
